# Guilford Press

> Guilford Press is a leading academic and professional publisher specializing in mental health, psychology, education, and research resources.

Guilford Press publishes books, journals, assessment scales, and digital resources across multiple disciplines. The company is known for evidence-based materials in psychology and education, including DBT and CBT resources, with a commitment to accessibility and digital innovation.

## Key Topics

- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Psychology & Psychiatry
- Education & Literacy
- Assessment Scales
- Academic Journals
- Digital Books & E-books
- Mental Health Publishing
- Accessibility Standards
- Book Series
- Subscription Management
- Self-Help & General Interest
- Geography & GIS
- Research Methods
- Professional Development

## Subject Areas & Catalogs

- [Psychology, Psychiatry, & Social Work](https://www.guilford.com/browse/psychology-psychiatry-social-work): Browse psychology, psychiatry, and social work titles including DBT and CBT resources.
- [Education](https://www.guilford.com/browse/education): Education book catalog featuring literacy, special education, and professional development.
- [Self-Help & General Interest](https://www.guilford.com/browse/self-help-general-interest): Self-help and general interest books on mindfulness, parenting, and relationships.
- [Assessment Scales](https://www.guilford.com/browse/assessment-scales): Psychological assessment scales and diagnostic tools including ADHD rating scales.
- [Geography](https://www.guilford.com/browse/geography): Geography titles covering cartography, GIS, and urban planning topics.
- [Politics & Philosophy](https://www.guilford.com/browse/politics-philosophy): Politics and philosophy books featuring critical theory and political science.

## Journals & Periodicals

- [Journals & Newsletters](https://www.guilford.com/browse/journals-newsletters): Browse Guilford academic journals and newsletters in psychology, health, and social criticism.
- [Renew Subscription](https://www.guilford.com/journals-newsletters/renew): Online journal and newsletter subscription renewal system for Guilford periodicals.

## Digital Products & Formats

- [e-Books](https://www.guilford.com/e-books): E-book formats and purchasing options including DRM-free ePub and WCAG-compliant access.

## Ordering & Account Management

- [Ordering Information](https://www.guilford.com/ordering-information): Order methods, shipping rates, and purchase information for Guilford titles.
- [Sign In or Create an Account](https://www.guilford.com/sign-in): User authentication and account creation page for Guilford.com.

## Resources for Educators

- [Information for Professors](https://www.guilford.com/professors): Professor copy requests, course adoption resources, and VitalSource integration.

## Customer Support

- [Contact Guilford](https://www.guilford.com/contact-guilford-press): Contact information for customer service, author submissions, and permissions.

## Optional
